style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE separate transparent landmark marker for a personal UAE travel scrapbook. The two input images are STYLE references only: match their restrained hand-painted acrylic flat shapes, delicate imperfect dark linework, visible dry-brush paper grain INSIDE the paint, and organic edges. Radically simplify the subject for clarity at 30px tall. No more than four main pigments. One isolated complete subject centered, filling 80–85% of a square canvas. Full composition, not lower half. Genuine transparent RGBA background around and through the subject; no paper sheet, white rectangle, checkerboard, cast shadow, scenery background, labels, titles, arrows, text, logos, watermark or border. Not pixel art, not 3D, not glossy, not photorealistic. Subject:

subjects.ferrari-world: Ferrari World on Yas Island: a sweeping low red three-pointed canopy seen from above at a slight angle, with a tiny white circle at its center. Red, warm ivory and charcoal; recognizable broad tri-lobed roof, not a racing car.
subjects.sea-world: SeaWorld Yas Island: a compact dolphin leaping over a small ocean-blue wave in front of a low pale rounded aquarium pavilion. Ocean blue, warm ivory, muted sand and charcoal.
subjects.museum-of-the-future: Dubai Museum of the Future: the recognizable silver elliptical torus building with an asymmetric open hollow center, sitting on a tiny olive mound. A few dark calligraphy-like abstract short etched strokes, no legible writing. Silver grey, pale ivory, muted olive and charcoal.
subjects.burj-khalifa: Dubai Burj Khalifa: one very tall slender stepped silver-blue skyscraper tapering through staggered setbacks to its fine needle spire. Maintain recognizable asymmetric stepped proportions, full spire visible. Slate blue, ivory, warm grey and charcoal.
subjects.old-deira: Old Deira in Dubai: a small traditional wooden abra boat on one minimal teal water stroke beside one sand-coloured wind-tower souk building. Tiny compact vignette, no skyline. Sand, umber, muted teal and ivory.
subjects.karama: Karama in Dubai: a small lived-in three-storey cream residential and shopfront block, simple balconies, window air conditioners, terracotta awning and tiny green street tree. No names, signage, people or skyline. Ivory, dusty terracotta, olive, dark umber.
subjects.dubai-frame: Dubai Frame: a single tall empty rectangular golden picture-frame monument with its two slim towers connected by a straight upper skybridge and a small low base. Huge transparent rectangle within. Muted gold, warm ochre, ivory, umber; sparse delicate texture.
subjects.skydive-desert: Skydive Dubai Desert Campus: a tiny skydiver suspended from a curved orange parachute above one small sandy dune stroke. Parachute, fine suspension lines and hanging human figure all clear. Muted rust-orange, sand, ivory and charcoal.
subjects.deep-dive: Deep Dive Dubai: a compact scuba diver with mask, tank and long fins descending diagonally beside a dark teal circular pool opening and a few tiny bubbles. Isolated underwater activity symbol, no enclosing background. Muted teal, navy, ivory and ochre.
subjects.desert-bike: Al Marmoom desert biking: a small orange four-wheel off-road quad bike with thick dark tires, side-three-quarter view on one pale sandy dune brushstroke. No rider, brands or words. Ochre, dusty orange, charcoal and ivory.
subjects.dibba-rock: Dibba Rock dive site: a small low rounded brown rocky offshore islet breaking through two short turquoise water strokes, with one tiny sea turtle beside it. Rock remains the principal subject. Sandy brown, grey umber, muted turquoise and olive.
subjects.abu-dhabi-mall: Abu Dhabi Mall: a compact modern warm-beige shopping mall facade with a blue-glass arched central entrance and one palm tree. Architectural shopping landmark, no lettering or brand names. Sand, muted blue, olive and umber.
subjects.dalma-mall: Dalma Mall in Abu Dhabi: a low broad cream modern mall with a curved blue-glass entrance, plus one small paintball mask resting near its base as a personal activity cue. Ivory, dusty blue, muted ochre and charcoal. No text or branding.
subjects.sharm-rock: Sharm Rock dive site off Fujairah: three small jagged sandstone rock pinnacles together just above two turquoise water brushstrokes, known as the Three Sisters. Three distinct low rocks, no turtle, no trees, no people, no boat. Sandy ochre, umber, turquoise and ivory.
